# Identification where bounded / 有界之处的辨识

<!-- Generated by tools/research/registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

`identification-where-bounded` · **recorded-checked** · theorem · F01 · [record](identification-where-bounded.json) · [register](../../../../RESULTS.md)

> A bounded record fixes the course at an exact length. With the bound given, induction is deduction; not given, the learner by the least bound is right from 2N − 1 on, as early as any learner can be: the bound buys silence, not speed. Finite names name the split that makes sense, with no quotient.
>
> 有界的记录确定历程，记录长度恰好。界给定时归纳即演绎；不给定界时，以最小的界读记录的学习者从 2N − 1 起每步都对，与任何学习者能做到的一样早：界给出沉默，不给出更早的静止。有限的名命名有意义的切分，不用商。

## Laws / 规律

1. Two periods (Fine–Wilf): a course with period p + 1 that comes back after Q steps at each of its first p steps comes back after Q steps at every step; two courses repeating from i, i′ with periods q + 1, q′ + 1 that agree before (i + q + 1) + (i′ + q′) agree at every step.<br>两个周期（Fine–Wilf）：周期为 p + 1、在前 p 步都在 Q 步后回来的历程在每一步都在 Q 步后回来；从 i、i' 起以周期 q + 1、q' + 1 重复的两个历程在 (i + q + 1) + (i' + q') 之前相同，就处处相同。 (`Becoming.Identification.period_extends`, `Becoming.Identification.lassos_agree`, `Becoming.Learning.Lasso`)
2. A course has at most N states (StatesBelow o N: every moment is one state with some moment before N) exactly where it repeats from some step i with some period q + 1, i + q + 1 ≤ N.<br>历程至多有 N 个状态（StatesBelow o N：每一时刻与 N 之前的某一时刻是同一状态），恰当它从某步 i 起以某个周期 q + 1 重复，且 i + q + 1 ≤ N。 (`Becoming.StatesBelow`, `Becoming.SameAhead`, `Becoming.Identification.statesBelow_iff_lasso`)
3. Two courses with at most N and at most N′ states that agree before N + N′ − 1 agree at every step; records are equal exactly where the courses agree before their length; so the record before N + N′ − 1 fixes the course.<br>至多 N 与至多 N' 个状态的两个历程在 N + N' − 1 之前相同，就处处相同；记录相等恰当历程在其长度之前相同；所以长 N + N' − 1 的记录确定历程。 (`Becoming.Identification.bounded_agree`, `Becoming.Identification.record_eq_iff`, `Becoming.Identification.record_fixes`, `Becoming.Learning.record`)
4. Given two values: for every T, a course with one state and one with at most T + 1 share their record before T and differ at T; for every M, two courses with at most M + 2 states share their record before M + M + 2 and differ there. For every M and M′, a course with at most M + 1 states and one with at most M′ + 1 share their record before M + M′ and differ at step M + M′: the length N + N′ − 1 is exact for every pair of bounds.<br>给出两个值：对每个 T，一个状态的历程与至多 T + 1 个状态的历程长 T 的记录相同而在 T 不同；对每个 M，两个至多 M + 2 个状态的历程长 M + M + 2 的记录相同而在那里不同。对每一对 M、M′，至多 M + 1 与至多 M′ + 1 个状态的两个历程，长 M + M′ 的记录相同而在第 M + M′ 步不同：长度 N + N′ − 1 对每一对界恰好。 (`Becoming.Identification.record_short`, `Becoming.Identification.mark`, `Becoming.Identification.record_short_twice`, `Becoming.Identification.bounded_agree_exact`)
5. With at most N states, two moments are one state exactly where what follows them agrees for N + N − 1 steps: the states are read off a finite record.<br>至多 N 个状态时，两个时刻是同一状态，恰当其后所识在 N + N − 1 步内相同：状态从有限的记录读出。 (`Becoming.Identification.sameAhead_iff_below`)
6. On a course with at most N states, a lasso (i, q) within N (i + q + 1 ≤ N) that holds on the record before N + N − 1 holds at every step; with values decided, a lasso hypothesis within N unrefuted before N + N − 1 is unrefuted everywhere, and one always is: induction is deduction.<br>至多 N 个状态的历程上，N 之内（i + q + 1 ≤ N）、在 N + N − 1 之前的记录上成立的套索 (i, q) 每步都成立；值可判定时，N 之内的套索假设在 N + N − 1 之前不被否证，就处处不被否证，且总有这样的假设：归纳即演绎。 (`Becoming.Identification.lasso_of_fits`, `Becoming.Identification.bounded_induction`, `Becoming.Identification.bounded_hypothesis`, `Becoming.Learning.lasso`, `Becoming.Learning.Holds`, `Becoming.Learning.RefutedAt`)
7. The learner given N (withBound N) is silent before N + N − 1 and then claims by the first lasso hypothesis within N that the record bears out; on every course with at most N states it is refuted nowhere and is right at every step from N + N − 1 on.<br>给定 N 的学习者（withBound N）在 N + N − 1 之前不说，之后以第一个在 N 之内、为记录所证实的套索假设主张；在每个至多 N 个状态的历程上，它处处不被否证，从 N + N − 1 起每步都对。 (`Becoming.Identification.withBound`, `Becoming.Identification.Fits`, `Becoming.Identification.BorneOut`, `Becoming.Identification.firstFit`, `Becoming.Identification.withBound_holds`, `Becoming.Identification.withBound_exact`)
8. None can always speak sooner: given two values, no learner is refuted nowhere on every course with at most M + 2 states and claims at step M + M + 2 on each.<br>没有学习者能总是更早说：给出两个值，没有学习者在每个至多 M + 2 个状态的历程上都处处不被否证、且在第 M + M + 2 步都作主张。 (`Becoming.Identification.withBound_earliest`)
9. withBound 2 is right about the two-valued negation at every step from 3 on; where other moves every value, the course answering the learner given N has more than N states.<br>withBound 2 对二值否定从第 3 步起每步都对；other 移动每个值时，回答给定 N 的学习者的历程超出 N 个状态。 (`Becoming.Identification.negation_derived`, `Becoming.Negation.register`, `Becoming.Identification.answer_exceeds_bound`)
10. With at most N states and values decided, a lasso hypothesis (a, b) within N, a ≤ s, unrefuted at every step from s to before s + (N + N − 1) is unrefuted at every step from s on; the learner by refutation over the lasso hypotheses claims and is right at every step from N + (N + N − 1) · tri N on; on a lasso course there is such a step.<br>至多 N 个状态且值可判定时，N 之内的套索假设 (a, b)（a ≤ s）在 s 到 s + (N + N − 1) 之前的每步不被否证，就从 s 起每步不被否证；对套索假设的按否证学习者从第 N + (N + N − 1) · tri N 步起每步主张且正确；套索历程上有这样的一步。 (`Becoming.Identification.unrefuted_persists`, `Becoming.Identification.learner_rests`, `Becoming.Identification.rests_of_lasso`, `Becoming.Learning.learner`, `Becoming.Learning.lassos`, `Becoming.Learning.tri`)
11. Where an orbit is held by a list l, the same holds with N the length of l.<br>轨道被列表 l 所持时，以 N 为 l 的长度亦然。 (`Becoming.Identification.held_learner_rests`, `Becoming.Law.orbit`)
12. For a list l closed under the law, members s, s′ have the same registered future exactly where those futures agree for l.length + l.length − 1 steps; where l holds every configuration, naming by the registered future of that length (Law.name) makes sense with no quotient, carries the law and, values decided, decides likeness.<br>列表 l 在律下封闭时，成员 s、s' 的所识的未来相同，恰当它们在 l.length + l.length − 1 步内相同；l 持有每个配置时，以这一长度的所识的未来命名（Law.name）有意义，不用商，承载规律，值可判定时判定相同。 (`Becoming.Law.SameFuture`, `Becoming.Law.sameFuture_iff_below`, `Becoming.Law.name`, `Becoming.IdentifiesAlike`, `Becoming.Law.name_identifiesAlike`, `Becoming.Law.name_carries`, `Becoming.Law.decideAlike`)
13. Moore's bound: under a determined law on a list of N members closed under it, with the members' values compared decidedly, two members have the same registered future exactly where they agree for N − 1 steps. Agreeing for k + 1 steps (Law.AgreeTo) is a chain of equivalences, each finer than the one before; members with different values make two classes, each strict refinement adds one, and members pairwise apart are no more than the list, so the chain stops refining within N − 2 steps and, the law being determined, never refines again. With no decision, that they agree everywhere is refuted by nothing. Exact for every N ≥ 2: on a path of N positions to a last one that stays, registering only whether the last is reached, the first two positions agree for N − 2 steps and differ at the next. Two moments of a history with at most N states and decided values are one state exactly where they agree for N − 1 steps.<br>Moore 界：确定的律下，N 个成员的列表对律封闭、成员的值判定相同时，两个成员的所识的未来相同，恰当它们在 N − 1 步内相同。在 k + 1 步内相同（Law.AgreeTo）是一条等价链，每一步比前一步细；值不同的成员给出两类，每次严格细分多一类，两两分开的成员不多于列表，所以链在 N − 2 步之内停止细分，律确定，此后不再细分。不判定时，处处相同不被否证。对每个 N ≥ 2 恰好：N 个位置的路径走到停住的最后一个，只识是否到了最后，前两个位置在 N − 2 步内相同而在下一步不同。值已定、至多 N 个状态的历史的两个时刻，恰在 N − 1 步内相同时是同一状态。 (`Becoming.Law.AgreeTo`, `Becoming.Law.agreeTo_iff`, `Becoming.Law.agreeTo_refining`, `Becoming.Law.AgreeTo.decided`, `Becoming.Law.AgreeTo.steady_on`, `Becoming.Law.sameFuture_iff_classes`, `Becoming.Law.sameFuture_classes_unrefuted`, `Becoming.Law.sameFuture_classes_exact`, `Becoming.Identification.sameAhead_iff_classes`, `Becoming.DistinctUnder`, `Becoming.DistinctUnder.length_le`, `Becoming.Refining`, `Becoming.SteadyAt`, `Becoming.Refining.grow`, `Becoming.Refining.steady_within`, `Becoming.not_not_within`)
14. Moore's bound with no premise: under a determined law on a list of N members closed under it, two members have the same registered future exactly where they agree for N − 1 steps, with no value compared decidedly. What is decided is the positions, not the values: the law is read on the positions of the list (Law.orbit_memberAt; finitely many existences chosen together, with no axiom of choice), whose equality is decided; joining, pair by pair, the two positions the record's agreement joins at each step (Law.merge, Law.joinOrbits) gives a labelling of the positions whose labels have one value each (Law.joinOrbits_sound); the labelling agrees for N − 1 steps, Moore's bound with decided values holds for it, and it carries over to the values. Two moments of a history with at most N states are one state exactly where they agree for N − 1 steps, with no premise too.<br>Moore 界不加前提：确定的律下，N 个成员的列表对律封闭时，两个成员的所识的未来相同，恰当它们在 N − 1 步内相同，不判定任何值。判定的是位置，不是值：律在列表的位置上读出（Law.orbit_memberAt；有限多个存在一并选出，不用选择公理），位置的相同是已定的；把记录中的一致在每一步所连的两个位置逐对合并（Law.merge、Law.joinOrbits），得到位置的一个标记，每个标记只有一个值（Law.joinOrbits_sound）；这个标记在 N − 1 步内一致，值已定的 Moore 界对它成立，再回到值。至多 N 个状态的历史的两个时刻，恰在 N − 1 步内相同时是同一状态，同样不加前提。 (`Becoming.Law.orbit_memberAt`, `Becoming.Law.choose_below`, `Becoming.Law.merge`, `Becoming.Law.SoundFor`, `Becoming.Law.merge_sound`, `Becoming.Law.joinOrbits`, `Becoming.Law.joinOrbits_sound`, `Becoming.Law.joinOrbits_joins`, `Becoming.Law.sameFuture_iff_within`, `Becoming.Identification.sameAhead_iff_within`)
15. The rest step needs no bound: the learner by the least bound (leastBound), given no bound, claims by the first lasso hypothesis the record bears out within the least bound within which one is (leastFit); it is right at every step from N + N − 1 on of every history with at most N states, for every N (leastBound_exact): what it finds is within the true bound, since the true hypothesis is borne out, and a hypothesis within N borne out before N + N − 1 holds everywhere. Given two values, no learner, given the bound or not, is right at step M + M + 2 on every history with at most M + 2 states (rest_earliest), so N + N − 1 is the optimal rest step for every learner, and being given the bound does not move it. What the bound buys is silence: no learner is both right at step 1 on every history with one state and refuted at no step of every history with two states (rest_without_bound_refuted); the learner given the bound is silent before N + N − 1 and refuted nowhere (the seventh law).<br>静止之步不需要界：以最小的界读记录的学习者（leastBound），不被给予界，按记录在其内证实某个套索假设的最小的界中第一个被证实的假设作主张（leastFit）；它在至多 N 个状态的每个历史上从 N + N − 1 起每步都对，对每个 N（leastBound_exact）：所找到的假设在真实的界之内，因为真实的假设被证实，而 N 之内、在 N + N − 1 之前被证实的假设处处成立。给定两个值，没有学习者（给定界与否）在每个至多 M + 2 个状态的历史上于第 M + M + 2 步都对（rest_earliest），所以 N + N − 1 是对每个学习者最优的静止之步，给定界不改变它。界给出的是沉默：没有学习者既在每个一个状态的历史上于第 1 步都对，又在每个两个状态的历史上处处不被否证（rest_without_bound_refuted）；给定界的学习者在 N + N − 1 之前沉默而处处不被否证（第七条规律）。 (`Becoming.Identification.orFit`, `Becoming.Identification.leastFit`, `Becoming.Identification.leastFit_sound`, `Becoming.Identification.leastFit_within`, `Becoming.Identification.leastBound`, `Becoming.Identification.leastBound_exact`, `Becoming.Identification.rest_earliest`, `Becoming.Identification.rest_without_bound_refuted`)
16. The learner by refutation rests at a cubic step: on the two-valued negation along a cycle of N = 2m + 3 places (oddCycle), with at most N states, it is refuted at step (N³ − N)/4 (learner_refuted_late), each even shift before the period N taking a whole turn; so no step before (N³ − N)/4 bounds its rest on every two-valued history with at most N states (learner_rest_cubic).<br>按否证学习者的静止之步是立方阶的：在 N = 2m + 3 个位置的环上的二值否定（oddCycle，至多 N 个状态）上，它在第 (N³ − N)/4 步被否证（learner_refuted_late），周期 N 之前每个偶数位移花去整整一圈；所以在至多 N 个状态的二值历史上，(N³ − N)/4 之前没有一步使它处处静止（learner_rest_cubic）。 (`Becoming.Identification.oddCycle`, `Becoming.Identification.oddCycle_below`, `Becoming.Identification.turnHeld`, `Becoming.Identification.even_shift_runs`, `Becoming.Identification.odd_shift_runs`, `Becoming.Identification.unit_shift_refuted`, `Becoming.Identification.turn_walk`, `Becoming.Identification.turn_diagonals`, `Becoming.Identification.learner_refuted_late`, `Becoming.Identification.learner_rest_cubic`)

## Conditions / 条件

- No axiom; no premise beyond the bound on states, written into each theorem (StatesBelow o N, or a world held by a list of length N).<br>不加公理；除了状态数的界不加前提：界写在每条定理之中（StatesBelow o N，或世界被长度为 N 的列表持有）。
- The learner and deciding likeness by names need registered values decided (DecidableEq O, DecidableEq R), the ‘values decided’ of learning-by-refutation; so does the learner by the least bound (leastBound); bounded_agree, lasso_of_fits, Law.name_identifiesAlike, rest_earliest and rest_without_bound_refuted do not. The sixteenth law is stated on two values (Bool), which are decided.<br>学习者与按名判定相同要所识的值可判定（DecidableEq O、DecidableEq R），即 learning-by-refutation 的“值可判定”；以最小的界读记录的学习者（leastBound）亦然；bounded_agree、lasso_of_fits、Law.name_identifiesAlike、rest_earliest 与 rest_without_bound_refuted 不要。第十六条规律陈述在两个值（Bool）上，值可判定。
- Only determined laws and single registered courses are stated; branching frames and probabilities are not.<br>只陈述确定的律与单个所识的历程；有分支的框架与概率没有陈述。
- Moore's bound in its counting form (Law.sameFuture_iff_classes, Identification.sameAhead_iff_classes) needs the members' values compared decidedly (Decided for each pair of the list, no decision procedure); Law.sameFuture_iff_within and Identification.sameAhead_iff_within do not: they decide positions (equality in Nat), not values. Law.sameFuture_classes_unrefuted does not, and states only that agreeing everywhere is refuted by nothing.<br>Moore 界以类计的形式（Law.sameFuture_iff_classes、Identification.sameAhead_iff_classes）要成员的值两两判定相同（对列表中的每一对，Decided，不要判定程序）；Law.sameFuture_iff_within 与 Identification.sameAhead_iff_within 不要：它们判定位置（Nat 的相等），不判定值。Law.sameFuture_classes_unrefuted 不要，只说处处相同不被否证。

## Does not show / 未表明

- The bound must hold (the course has at most N states); the learner need not be given it (the fifteenth law), but with no bound no record fixes the next value.<br>界必须成立（历程至多有 N 个状态）；学习者不必被给予它（第十五条规律），但没有界时没有记录确定下一个值。
- The exact rest step of the learner by refutation is not shown: for odd N it comes after (N³ − N)/4 (the sixteenth law) and is at most N + (2N − 1)·tri N (the tenth law), so it is cubic; exhaustive search over two-valued histories with at most N states (N ≤ 17) and three-valued ones (N ≤ 9) finds the worst rest step (N³ − N)/4 + 3 for odd N ≥ 3, a computation, not a proof. The optimum over learners is 2N − 1 (the fifteenth law).<br>按否证学习者的确切静止之步没有表明：对奇数 N 它在 (N³ − N)/4 之后（第十六条规律），并至多是 N + (2N − 1)·tri N（第十条规律），所以是立方阶；对至多 N 个状态的二值历史（N ≤ 17）与三值历史（N ≤ 9）的穷举，找到奇数 N ≥ 3 的最坏静止之步是 (N³ − N)/4 + 3，这是计算，不是证明。对每个学习者最优的是 2N − 1（第十五条规律）。
- **Counterexample / 反例:** record_short: a course with one state and one with T + 1 share their record before T and differ at T; record_short_twice: two courses with M + 2 states (marking every M + 2 and every M + 1 steps) share their record before M + M + 2 and differ there; bounded_agree_exact: for every M and M′, the course marking one step in every M + 1, with a mark at M + M′, and the course following it before M′ and unmarked from then on share their record before M + M′ and differ there; answer_exceeds_bound: the course answering the learner given N exceeds N states; Law.sameFuture_classes_exact: for every M, on the path of M + 2 positions to a last one that stays, registering only whether the last is reached, the first two positions agree for M steps and differ at step M; learner_refuted_late: on the two-valued negation along a cycle of N = 2m + 3 places the learner by refutation is refuted at step (N³ − N)/4.<br>record_short：一个状态的历程与 T + 1 个状态的历程有相同的长 T 的记录而在 T 不同；record_short_twice：两个 M + 2 个状态的历程（每 M + 2 步与每 M + 1 步标记一次）有相同的长 M + M + 2 的记录而在那里不同；bounded_agree_exact：对每一对 M、M′，以周期 M + 1 标记、标记落在第 M + M′ 步的历程，与在第 M′ 步之前随它、之后不标记的历程，有相同的长 M + M′ 的记录而在那里不同；answer_exceeds_bound：回答给定 N 的学习者的历程超出 N 个状态；Law.sameFuture_classes_exact：对每个 M，M + 2 个位置走到停住的最后一个、只识是否到了最后的路径上，前两个位置在 M 步内相同而在第 M 步不同；learner_refuted_late：在 N = 2m + 3 个位置的环上的二值否定上，按否证学习者在第 (N³ − N)/4 步被否证。 [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Identification.lean)

### Correspondence / 对应

Ren's speculation on 12 October 2026, ‘the full "truth" can be derived, situationally, including the cognition/controller part’, and the later ‘keep prove to the deepest … for the open questions, if they need to be answered to move forward, answer them’: this answers the last two questions Description, Diagonal and Context left open, deriving the law from a finite record and naming with no axiom the classes of the split that makes sense. Learning by refutation gives the side with no bound (no record fixes the next value; the learner's coming to rest is unrefuted); this gives the side with the bound given, its exact boundary, and the step by which the learner not given the bound rests, which the bound gives and the learner's record does not show. Known results: Fine and Wilf's two periods (1965), Moore's finite experiments (1956), Gold's identification in the limit (1967), here reproved in the core with no axiom and connected. Readings (the AI's, adopted on Ren's delegation, DELEGATED-CHOICES D34; the finite name taken by Ren on 16 October 2026 as an analogy, “take 2”: the theorem is that within a bound kinds have finite names, and 名可名 is an analogy only): a finite record is a projection, which the bound makes lose nothing of the course; the controller is inside the bounded world, and only a world answering it defeats it, which exceeds the bound; with a bound, a class's name is its finite future; being given the bound and not being given it differ in when the learner is right and whether it can know it is, not in whether it ends right. Ren, 15 October 2026, did not take ‘situationally means the bound’ as theirs (“not sure what's the reading 1, but reality is always situational”); the reading's qualification is in identification-where-runs-part and typicality-by-counting.<br>Ren 2026-10-12 的推测“the full "truth" can be derived, situationally, including the cognition/controller part”与其后的“keep prove to the deepest … for the open questions, if they need to be answered to move forward, answer them”：这里回答 Description、Diagonal 与 Context 留下的后两个开放问题：从有限的记录推出律，以及不加公理命名有意义的切分的类。learning-by-refutation 给出不用界的一面（没有记录确定下一个值；学习者静止这一点不被否证）；这里给出界给定的一面与恰好的边界，并给出未给定界的学习者静止之步（由界给出，学习者的记录不表明它）。已知的结果：Fine 与 Wilf（1965）的两个周期定理，Moore（1956）的有限实验，Gold（1967）的极限中的辨识；这里在核心中不用公理重证并连成一体。读法（AI 的，依 Ren 的交托采用，DELEGATED-CHOICES D34；有限的名由 Ren 2026-10-16 取作类比，“take 2”：定理是有界时类有有限的名，“名可名”只是类比）：有限的记录是一个投影，界使它对历程不失去什么；控制者在有界的世界之内，只有回答它的世界使它落空，而那超出界；有界时类的名是它的有限的未来；给定界与未给定界的差别在何时对与能否知道已对，不在最后是否对。Ren 2026-10-15 未把“按情境就是界”取为自己的（“not sure what's the reading 1, but reality is always situational”）；这一读法的限定见 identification-where-runs-part 与 typicality-by-counting。
